product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo is a cloud-based, isolated browser that enables intelligence and security teams to investigate the web anonymously without exposing their identity, location, or mission.
product_one_liner.notes: Authentic8 describes its product as helping intelligence and security teams investigate the digital world without exposing who they are, where they are, or what they are working on; the one-liner restates this function and audience.

pricing_page.notes: Authentic8 has a public page titled Plans and Pricing, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Authentic8’s customer success story identifies MindPoint Group SOC as the organization using Silo; another Authentic8 success story names Secure Network Technologies. | named_customers.0: The success story identifies MindPoint Group SOC as the organization for which Silo Workspace is the featured product. | named_customers.1: The success story names Secure Network Technologies.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 127 employees, which falls within the requested 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Authentic8’s official third-party-processors page footer gives its address in Redwood City, California. | hq_country: The LEI record identifies the headquarters country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Authentic8’s About Us page says it was established in 2010, directly supporting the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Authentic8 has a blog index, whose displayed subjects are marketing/product topics (for example OSINT collaboration and VPN/managed-attribution explainers), not multiple engineering-authored posts describing how the product is built; therefore the engineering-blog criterion is not met.

public_docs.notes: Authentic8 publishes a substantive Silo Nexus AI support article and a separate User Management API reference guide, establishing public product documentation across multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Authentic8 job-board entries reviewed were Sales Development Representative and Governance Administration Specialist, with no AI, ML, or data-science role title.
